This is now the second time Jazy-Blues has gone to Glamour Pets for her nails and an ozone spa treatment, and we are really happy that we found this place. This treatment was recommended to us when we had just arrived in the Netherlands. It might sound like a luxury spa thing for dogs, but actually, it is just really good care and therefore necessary for our fur-kids.

Initially, we only came because her nails needed to be done; they had grown too long during her time on the street, and I don't dare do that myself, being way too afraid of cutting into the quick. And that also has to be done in stages, which we prefer to leave to professionals.

That is also where we discovered the ozone spa treatment. That isn't just any bath: it works antibacterially and is very good for skin and coat. Thanks to the warm water, the bubbles, and the ozone, it really penetrates the skin well. Jazy-Blues comes from a warm country and had to get used to the Dutch climate quite a bit, so such a treatment visibly does her good. Afterwards, her coat is soft, clean, and healthy. Something else we only recently discovered here: Jazy-Blues has a short coat, and a dog grooming salon really isn't just for dogs with long coats that need clipping. Keeping nails trimmed, skin and coat care, a good bath… that is actually just nice for any dog ​​to do every now and then.

At Glamour Pets, you immediately notice that they work with love *and* knowledge. Everyone is friendly and professional, Jazy-Blues is treated calmly and with care, and appointments are very easy to make via WhatsApp and email. And while you have a moment to yourself, Mommy got updates from Jazy in a warm bath ♥️

And another little bonus: we found a great bodywarmer for Jazy-Blues that folds up into a small bag. Ideal for the treacherous Dutch weather: sun in the afternoon, cold later in the day. Open the bag, put the jacket on, and Jazy is warm and happy.

A warm, friendly, professional salon where dogs aren't just a number, but are truly seen.
And when your dog walks in relaxed, you basically already know enough. The next appointments are already scheduled, and that brings peace of mind too 🤗

Note: Jazy’s nails were too long because she had lived on the streets. Jazy-Blues isn't named that for nothing: Jazy for the cheerful dog she is now, Blues for where she came from. Dumped on the street with her pups. That is why it touches me every time I see her lying there peacefully in that warm bath. From the street to the spa – sometimes a whole new life lies in something as simple as the care every animal is entitled to 💫🙏🏽
